title: #669 review blocker: receipt.json still disagrees with the HUD when a quality measure could not be measured
context: Review found FR-20/AC-9 unmet on the default path. The bundle receipt is now sealed after every gate, but it also counts quality-ratchet measures the ratchet could not compute as 'blocked' rows (src/quality-ratchet/ratchet.ts:76), and any blocked row makes verification_result INCONCLUSIVE (src/evidence/receipt/statement.ts:86). The HUD verdict comes from gate statuses only (run-repository-verification.ts:764), and the ratchet gate passes, so the HUD says Safe to merge. Proof in this repo: the 667 bundle receipt (blocked=3) reads INCONCLUSIVE while its session HUD verdict reads Safe to merge, and 4 of the last 10 receipts show the same. The agreement test has no ratchet-blocked case, and the #669 changeset says they match.
